skill.summary: Generates multi-themed food collages (Viral Cakes, Street Food, Smoothie Bowls, Coffee Art, Fusion Tacos). Use when user asks for a collage of specific food...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of design-pick.
- Added script for generating themed food collages.
- Supports multiple themes: Viral Cakes, Street Food, Smoothie Bowls, Coffee Art, and Fusion Tacos.
- Generates 3x3 collage layouts with circular-masked images and dynamic "PICK" titles.
